title: Pub Carols at The Pig & Whistle
summary: A group carols night with a live band and two-course meal at The Pig & Whistle in Main Ridge. The organiser lists Thursday 3, 10 and 17 December, each from 6pm to 10pm.
recurrenceNote: Thursday 3, 10 and 17 December 2026, 6–10pm; no further dates confirmed.
verificationNote: The event-specific Humanitix page returned HTTP 200 on 15 October 2026. Its structured event data confirms Thursday 3, 10 and 17 December 2026, each 6–10pm AEDT, at 365 Purves Road, Main Ridge. The page says a ticket includes a main and dessert and describes a band-led group singalong. A previously archived 17 December Pub Carols record cited a different retired Humanitix URL that returned 404; this current three-date listing uses the live event page. Price and remaining places were not independently confirmed.
editorVerdict: A participatory carols evening for groups rather than a background music dinner. Choose a Thursday and check Humanitix for current ticket terms.
editorNote:
The Pig & Whistle's Pub Carols nights combine a two-course meal with a live band. The organiser says the band teaches each table part of a song before bringing the room together for a final performance. It is presented as a group or end-of-year party evening.

Humanitix lists Thursday 3, 10 and 17 December, 6–10pm, at 365 Purves Road, Main Ridge. Select the correct date on the booking page and check the current price, remaining places and group arrangements before travelling.
